description: This file defines the 'RetrieveAttributeResponse' class, which represents the response to a 'RetrieveAttribute' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages the JSON serialization/deserialization of the response, encapsulates the retrieved attribute data, and provides methods for creating instances from various inputs. The class is immutable and builds upon a base command response class, integrating with JSON and HTTP header handling.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response received when retrieving an attribute from a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains the thing's ID, the JSON pointer to the attribute, the attribute's value, and related metadata. Provides serialization and deserialization methods to/from JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveAttributeResponse instance with specified ThingId, attribute JSON pointer, attribute value, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveAttributeResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object, extracting necessary fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity associated with this response.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the retrieved attribute's JSON value.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the attribute value as per a given JSON schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the attribute value replaced by the given JSON value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer path to the attribute resource.
